statements.statement: The patient has persistent palpitations and episodes of dizziness in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias contributing to these symptoms
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197
The CO-197 denial concerns missing precertification or authorization
The diagnosis codes are I34.0, R00.2, R42
